criteria.description: Executable decomposition is refused until architecture, data flow, risk, compatibility, migration, and validation strategy are validated and approved.

criteria.description: Every required specification outcome maps to work, and every work item traces to approved plan scope.

criteria.description: Unknown, self, direct, and lane-collapse dependency cycles fail before finalization.

criteria.description: Handoff, review, acceptance, and integration reject work whose generation disposition no longer permits the action.

criteria.description: Action-capable outcomes record the exact actor profile, doctrine identity and revisions, digest, and granted authority.
